title: Statistically Steady Holographic Quantum Turbulence: Hyperuniform Vortex Matter and Crossover
summary: A long-standing obstacle in quantum turbulence has been the difficulty of sustaining robust statistical steady states, preventing unambiguous identification of universal vortex organization and kinetic scaling. We construct such a steady state in two-dimensional holographic superfluid turbulence by continuous Landau-instability driving, sustaining ${\sim}2500$ vortices free from transient artifacts.
